story.title: Learning the ropes
story.about: Someone's showing you how things work here: making friends, the card shop, quests, time, your deck, and a first duel.

objectives.text: Finish the tour with your guide

endings.title: Lesson learned
endings.scene: World: Story, C1 After the lesson

story.title: Champion of the arena
story.about: {mentor} says to come back once you've won the weekly tournament at the arena.

story.title: A true friend
story.about: {mentor} wants to see you make a real friend in town, a best friend, before what comes next.

script: them (pleased): So you've made a best friend. Tell me, what did they do to earn that?
player: They stuck around when I lost.
them: That's the kind of friend that counts. I'm proud of you.
them (pleased): Keep them close. What comes next will be harder than this.

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 After the lesson
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background arena
guide enters center with fade
guide: That's the lesson. You played a proper game, and that's all I wanted to see.
player: Was that a good game, then?
guide (lose): Win or lose, you learned the table. Here's 1,500 coins to spend on packs at the shop. Buy a few and see what you get.
guide: When you've won the weekly tournament, come back and find me. I'll want to hear about your friends, too.
guide: The tournament is at the arena. Enter on Saturday, and bring your best deck on Sunday.
player: I'll be there.

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 Champion
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background arena
guide enters center with fade
guide (lose): You won the tournament! Champion of the arena.
player: I did it.
if has_best_friend goto proud
guide: You haven't made a best friend yet, though. That's what I want to see before we take on what's next.
guide: Find someone you really click with. Keep talking to them, give them what they love, and win them over.
player: How long will that take?
guide: As long as it takes. Come back when you've got one, and tell me who.
end
label proud
guide (lose): And you've already got a best friend. I'm proud of you, honestly.
player: Thanks.
guide: Friends are what carry you through this town. Come and tell me who they are.
end

scenes.name: World: Story, C1 Chapter end
script: cast guide as {mentor}
background sakura
guide enters center with fade
guide (lose): A true friend. That's what I was waiting for you to find.
player: What happens now?
guide: The town opens up a little more. There are people who've been waiting to meet you, and a few with questions.
guide (lose): What's coming next is about them. I'll be around if you need me.
player: Thanks, for everything.
guide: That's what friends are for. See you around.

*: narrator: The town square is busy and bright. Nobody here seems to be in a hurry.
narrator: You don't recognise anyone. The sign on the gate is in a language you can read, but the place feels strange.
narrator: A few people are standing around the plaza. Some are chatting, some are reading, one is hitting a training dummy with great enthusiasm.
narrator: You could wander around and hope to work it out. Or you could ask someone.
narrator: You decide to ask someone.
player: Excuse me... where am I?
them: Oh! You're new, {player}, aren't you? I can always tell. Don't worry, it's like this for everyone when they first get here.
player: But where is here?
them: Here is... here. The best place to start. Come on, I'll show you around.
Aang: player: Excuse me... where am I?
them (pleased): Whoa, you're new! Don't worry, it's like this for everyone when they first get here.
player: But where is here?
them: Ha! That's the question everyone asks. Let's just say here is wherever you're standing. Come on, I'll show you around!
Chisato Nishikigi: player: Excuse me... where am I?
them (pleased): Oh, hi! You're new, right? It's totally normal, everyone looks like that on their first day.
player: But where is here?
them: Here? It's the best place in the world, obviously! Let me show you round, it'll be fun.
Asuna Yuuki: player: Excuse me... where am I?
them: You're new here, I can tell. It's like this for everyone at first, don't worry about it.
player: But where is here?
them (pleased): That's a long story, and I'd rather show you than tell you. Come on, let me show you around.

them: New arrival. Obvious. It's the same for everyone who first comes here, so don't be alarmed.
player: But where is here?
them: Here is where you start. Walk with me, I'll show you the way.

*: them: Let's talk about making friends. You can talk to anyone in town once a day, and each talk helps you get closer.
them: Friendship runs from Stranger, through Acquaintance and Friend, all the way to Best friend.
them: Each step unlocks something, and the best friends have a story to tell.
them: Go on, press Talk and say hello to me.
Aang: them (pleased): Friends are the best part of this place! Talk to someone once a day, and you'll get closer to them.
them: Stranger, Acquaintance, Friend, all the way up to Best friend. Each one's a step closer.
them: Go on, press Talk and say hi!
Chisato Nishikigi: them (pleased): Okay, so, talking! Once a day with anyone, and you get closer. It's like a little café chat.
them: There are ranks, from Stranger all the way to Best friend. Each one's a bit more special.
them (pleased): Go on, press Talk and tell me something cool!
Asuna Yuuki: them: Talking to people is how you make friends. Once a day, with anyone, and each talk brings you closer.
them: The ranks go from Stranger up to Best friend. The closer you get, the more they'll look out for you.
them: Go on, press Talk, and tell me how your day's going.
Erza Scarlet: them: Friendship is built one talk at a time. Once a day with anyone, and the ranks climb from Stranger to Best friend.
them: Each rank means more trust. You'll need it.
them: Press Talk.

*: them: Gifts are the other way in. Everyone loves some things, likes others, and dislikes a few.
them: A loved gift does the most good. A liked one helps. A disliked one can set someone back.
them: You can give each person one gift a day, so make it count.
them: Go on, press Give a gift, and pick something for me.
Aang: them (pleased): Here's a tip: I love cute things, and I like sweet and calm ones. Spicy things, not so much!
them: Gifts that someone loves do the most good. Liked ones help. Disliked ones can set someone back.
them: You can give one gift a day to each person. Go on, press Give a gift!
Chisato Nishikigi: them (pleased): Gifts make everyone happy! Things people love make them happiest, things they like help too.
them: Only one gift a day per person, so choose carefully.
them (pleased): Go on, press Give a gift and surprise me!
Asuna Yuuki: them: A gift is a way of showing you know someone. Loved things do the most good, liked things help, disliked things don't.
them: One gift a day per person. Think about what they'd really enjoy.
them: Go on, press Give a gift, and pick one for me.
Erza Scarlet: them: Gifts. Each person loves some things, likes others, and dislikes some. Know the difference.
them: One gift a day per person. Do not waste them.
them: Press Give a gift.

*: them: Now let's look at the map. Every place in town is on it, and you can see who's there.
them: People come and go. Some are only out at certain times of day.
them: Anyone with a name is somewhere in town. Click them to talk, give a gift, or duel.
them: Let's go to the card shop. Open the map and choose the shop.
Aang: them (pleased): Okay, the map! Every place in town is on it, and it shows who's there right now.
them: People come and go, so check it every time you want someone.
them: Let's go to the card shop! Open the map and pick the shop.
Chisato Nishikigi: them (pleased): This is the map! All the places are on here, and little pictures show who's around.
them: Everyone's got their own days, so the map helps you find them.
them (pleased): Let's go to the card shop! Open the map and tap it.

them: We're going to the card shop. Open the map and choose the shop.

*: them: This is the card shop. Packs are the main thing: each one has a handful of cards from a set.
them: There are specialty packs, single cards, and gifts too. Everything you pick goes in the basket until you check out.
them: Specialty packs have better odds for one kind of card. Single cards are on the rack, a few rares a day.
them: Let's buy you a pack. Press Add 1 on a set, then Check out.
Aang: them (pleased): The shop! Packs are the big thing here. Each one has cards from a set.
them: Everything you pick goes in the basket, and nothing's bought until you check out.
them: Press Add 1 on a set, then Check out. Let's go!
Chisato Nishikigi: them (pleased): Ooh, the shop! Packs, single cards, and gifts, all in one place.
them: Whatever you pick goes in your basket. You only pay when you check out.
them (pleased): Add 1 on a set, then check out! My treat for the first one.
Asuna Yuuki: them: The card shop. Packs have cards from a set, and there are specialty packs and single cards too.
them: Your basket keeps everything you pick, until you check out and pay.
them: Press Add 1 on a set to buy a pack, then Check out.
Erza Scarlet: them: Packs, specialty packs, single cards, gifts. Pick what you need, and check it in the basket.
them: Nothing is bought until you check out.
them: Add 1 on a set. Then check out.

*: them: Some people in town have quests for you. Look for the ! over someone's head.
them: Quests are kept in the quest log. The notice board has the weekly notices too.
them: Press Quests and open the log, so you can see what's there.
Aang: them (pleased): See the ! over someone's head? That means they've got a quest for you!
them: The quest log keeps everything, and the notice board has the weekly ones.
them: Press Quests and have a look!

them: The quest log is where they're all kept. The notice board has the weekly ones too.

Erza Scarlet: them: A quest is marked with a ! above someone.
them: The log keeps them. The notice board has the weekly ones.

*: them: Time matters here. Each day has four parts: morning, noon, evening and night.
them: Talking to someone or duelling uses up that part of the day. You can't do it twice.
them: When there's nothing left to do, pass time. The town carries on without you.
them: Go on, press Pass time.
Aang: them (pleased): Time moves in four parts: morning, noon, evening and night.
them: Talking or duelling uses that part of the day, so choose well!
them: When you're done, press Pass time to move on.
Chisato Nishikigi: them (pleased): Okay, so there are four parts of the day: morning, noon, evening and night!
them: Chatting or duelling spends that part of the day. Then you pass time to move on.
them (pleased): Press Pass time when you're ready!
Asuna Yuuki: them: Each day has four parts: morning, noon, evening and night.

Erza Scarlet: them: Four parts of the day. Morning, noon, evening, night.

*: them: Now your deck. You build decks only from cards you've opened, and you can have several.
them: The equipped one is the deck you duel with.
them: To be legal it needs 50 cards, 8 climaxes, and at most 4 of any one card.
them: Go on, open Decks and build a legal one.

them: A legal deck needs 50 cards, 8 climaxes, and no more than 4 of one card. Press Decks!
